disposition_reason: Table 2 prints per-phase and mean dry-weight concentrations of Cr, Cd, Pb, Ni, Cu, Zn, Fe and Mn in potato, ginger, garlic and onion from Kawran Bazar.

study.design: Repeated market survey (4 purchase phases, at least 14 days apart, over 2 months) with health risk assessment
study.origin: vegetables supplied to Kawran Bazar mainly from Savar, Munshiganj, Narsingdi, Mymensingh, Kishoregonj, Rajshahi, Jessore, Kushtia, Bogra, Chittagong (as stated)
study.market: Kawran Bazar wholesale vegetable market, Dhaka, Bangladesh

period.as_reported: four phases over 2 months; calendar dates not reported

study.method: HNO3/HClO4 hot-plate digestion of 1 g dried sample; AAS (Varian AA 240)
